title: Send flow: envelope can be sent with zero recipients, no validation shown
steps:
1. Open http://13.207.185.159/ and sign in ([USERNAME] / [PASSWORD]).
2. Dashboard → Start → Upload sample.pdf.
3. Leave Recipients empty.
4. Click Next.
5. Click Send.
expected: In DocuSign, Send is blocked and an inline error asks for at least one recipient.
actual: Envelope is created and appears in Manage with status "Sent" and no recipient.
notes: Validation likely runs on the Recipients screen only, not on submit.
